name: 77531 · Clute, TX
findings: ZIP 77531 (Clute) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77531 (Clute) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77531 (Clute) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
